summary: Intent-bus refactor PASSED all 8 review_request flows including the two new native-hardening cases. Flow-by-flow: (1) qa-donation → navigates to /module/donations AND donation-sheet auto-opens ✓. (2) After closing sheet and returning to Home, qa-donation opens the sheet AGAIN on 2nd tap — proves intents.consume() clears pending and each set() re-fires useFocusEffect ✓ (this is what iteration_7's URL-param approach failed on native). (3) Direct URL navigation to /module/donations (bypassing Home) does NOT auto-open the sheet ✓ — intents.peek() returns null. (4) Saved Ramesh ₹500 (partial OFF, phone +919876543210, mode cash): sheet closed, row rendered, stat-donations went ₹11,118 → ₹11,618 (Δ=+500), stat-balance ₹4,418 → ₹4,918 ✓. (5) qa-expense → navigates AND expense-sheet auto-opens ✓. (6) Twice-in-a-row: back to Home, tap qa-expense again → sheet reopens ✓. (7) Saved ₹300 / category=food / vendor='Sri Krishna' / desc='Prasadam' — sheet closed, stat-expenses ₹6,700 → ₹7,000 (Δ=+300), stat-balance ₹4,918 → ₹4,618 ✓. (8) Regression: header '+' (new-donation-button, new-expense-button) still opens the same sheets with 'Log a donation'/'Add expense' titles ✓. Also confirmed direct nav to /module/expenses without going through Home does NOT auto-open the sheet ✓. Only pre-existing non-blocking `shadow* style props are deprecated` warnings (RN Web) — no red screens, no errors, no pageerrors. Intent-bus architecture (/app/frontend/src/intents.ts) is correct: single pending slot, subscriber notification via Set<cb>, consume clears + returns bool, useFocusEffect consumers wrap openNew().
action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup already noted in iteration_7: replace remaining `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` for RN Web parity.
critical_code_review_comments: intents.ts: subs Set is fine, but nothing currently subscribes (only imperative consume in useFocusEffect) — the subscribe/notify plumbing is dead code today. Safe to keep for future reactive use; consider a short comment. Not a bug.

Both consumer screens use useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { if (intents.consume(...)) openNew(); }, []))  — deps=[]  is intentional (openNew is a stable closure via useState setters). Correct on both native and web.
Home Quick Actions call intents.set() BEFORE router.push() — order matters and is correct (target screen's focus effect will run after navigation).
No leaked intent across screens verified: after consume, peek() returns null, so navigating away and back manually does not re-trigger the sheet. Verified by flow 3.

rca_of_issue: Original mobile bug: 'Log Expense tap just refreshes screen instead of opening form'. Root cause was iteration_7's URL-param mechanism (`router.push('/module/expenses?open=new')` + `useEffect([params.open])`) — on native Expo Go, when the target screen was already mounted in the nav stack, pushing the same URL with the same param value did not re-fire the effect (React Navigation deduped). Fix (this iteration): in-memory intents bus with `intents.set(name)` before `router.push`, and consumer screens using `useFocusEffect(() => { if (intents.consume(name)) openNew(); })`. useFocusEffect fires on EVERY focus (including when returning to an already-mounted screen), and consume() flushes the pending value so it's one-shot per navigation. Verified: (a) 2nd tap of qa-donation/qa-expense after returning to Home reopens the sheet, (b) direct URL nav to /module/donations|expenses does NOT open the sheet, (c) intent is consumed exactly once (returning to the screen without a new set() does not reopen). No mitigation steps needed — fix is complete and correct.
